email.body1:
Mitchell, saw Graylog ship the Spring 2026 release with automated investigations and behavioral detection.

A launch like that floods the funnel with in-market accounts faster than reps can research, write, and follow up, so signal-to-action latency becomes the constraint. Our AI SDR closes that loop autonomously, scaling coverage 3-5x per rep without new headcount, every email auto-logged to the CRM.

I built a personalized signal play for Graylog off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Mitchell, quick follow-up for Graylog.

For RevOps the pain is the lag between a signal firing and a rep actually acting on it, plus the data hygiene that quietly decays in between. Tighten that loop and the pipeline lift is measurable, not anecdotal, and it shows up the same quarter you make the change.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Mitchell, last bit of proof for Graylog.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Graylog's reply rate likely compares to other security software teams. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your revenue motion? I'll tailor it to Graylog either way.
